title: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd - completed acquisition of Hunter Waste

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Transpacific has acquired from Ron J Hunter & Sons Pty Ltd the businesses trading as Hunter's Septic Tank Cleaning, Hunter Waste, Leongatha Septic Tank Cleaning Services and Traralgon Septic Cleaning.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the completed acquisition in the context of markets for non-hazardous liquid waste collection in the South Gippsland region of Victoria.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the completed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets since Transpacific had not been actively servicing the geographic area.
